feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 June 2026 6:00am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 26 June 2026 at 5:25am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure lies over northern Scotland, with a shallow low now over Ireland and southern Britain.


##Wind##

Variable 3 to 5, gradually settling and increasing South or Southwest 5 or 6 later this morning and afternoon, possibly 7 for a time in southwest of area, although staying 3 or 4 in the southeast of the area. Decreasing mainly South 4 or 5 tonight, occasionally 6 in west, still 3 or 4 in southeast.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building mostly moderate, except in Liverpool Bay and Morecambe Bay.


##Weather##

Thundery showers soon clearing, mist and fog patches developing.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers, poor or very poor in mist and fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Soon becoming mainly South 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, again 3 or 4 in the southeast of the area. Little change for the rest of the day, then veering Southwest 4 or 5 in all waters overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, locally slight in Liverpool Bay and Morecambe Bay.


##Weather##

Mist and fog patches, outbreaks of rain later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog patches.
